assignments.role: Backend Strict Opt-In, Job Sandboxing & Creative Variety Engine
assignments.scope: 1) Strict Opt-In Architecture: All secondary features (subtitles, phone overlays, music) disabled by default unless explicitly requested in prompt. 2) Job Sandbox Isolation: Confine all intermediate artifacts, keyframes, audio slices, and renders to per-job isolated directory outputs/jobs/<job_id>/. 3) Creative Variety Engine: Stochastic LLM sampling and dynamic narrative hooks in web/vision_analyzer.py to avoid repetitive outputs on identical videos. 4) Author tests in tests/test_optin_sandboxing_and_creative_variety.py. 5) Zero U+0669, update web/README.md, commit as MohammedBoure, and signal idle.

assignments.role: Frontend Opt-In Toggles, Sandboxed Telemetry & Script Inspection UX
